text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Oka Sho close at
hand, we
finish up with training for the
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's almost here.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Which means we should make sure to rest.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I can't afford to fall ill here. That
goes for
you too.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I follow Эйр Грув's gaze to find an
Umamusume
running with a determined
look on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, that's Мэдзиро Добер.
She
came to support Эйр Грув at her
debut race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You head on back.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
She told me to go on ahead, but... I can't
help but
feel curious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I watch quietly from a distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: You're pushing yourself too hard.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I don't recall teaching you to train in
such a
self-destructive way.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ngh.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: What happened?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'm just so angry at myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I'm so weak... so useless!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
McQueen and Ryan are both so far
ahead of me...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
All the attention that comes with being
an
Umamusume from the Mejiro family...
It doesn't
faze them at all. They just
keep delivering results.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But look at me! I still get crushed by my
nerves! I
can't even run properly!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Every day I'm falling further behind, and
it's so...
painful. I hate it, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But I can't do anything about it! I'm so
weak... I
hate myself!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Sniff...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Dober... What is your ideal?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: My what?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
When you freeze and lose sight of your
path,
uncertain of what you were aiming
for. When you
forget what it was you
wanted to be.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Look inside your heart for the
unshakable core
that reminds you of
what truly matters. That is
your "ideal."
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: My ideal is my mother.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle with a talented
rival, my
mother won the Japanese Oaks
and became a
queen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I will never forget her dignified stature
that day.
When her hard work had paid
off, and the glory
she had sought was
finally hers. I looked up to her
so much
at that moment.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become just like her. That's
why I
came to this academy and took on
the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
When I'm tripped up by some trouble
and am in
danger of losing my way...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's when my ideal guides me. It
always tells me
where I need to go.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I will win the Japanese Oaks for myself
and catch
up to my mother—my ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And one day I'll surpass her and take on
realms
unknown. As Empress, I'll guide
all Umamusume
forward.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm working so hard right
now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I keep running specifically because of
that
dazzling ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: So, let me ask you this, Dober.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What is your ideal?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: My ideal...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
My goal has always been... to not be an

embarrassment to the Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I look up to McQueen and Ryan... and
yet more
than anything, I don't want to
lose to them...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Эйр Грув... I don't know the
answer... I
don't think I have an ideal...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I see. In that case...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Chase after me, Dober.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: After you?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
My desire is to lead all Umamusume.
That means
being everyone's ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: If you don't have one of your own...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Let me be your ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
To prove it, I ask you to watch me take
on the
Triple Tiara series.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll prove that I am worthy of becoming
your ideal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Keep yourself warm. It would be a real
shame to
catch a cold right now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I thought I told you to head back.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Sigh... This appears to be a common thing with you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: We can do it—let's make you everyone's ideal.

text_block_list.text: Indeed.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
As we stand together in the twilight, I
renew my
vow to support Эйр Грув in
her goal of
becoming everyone's ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
